scenarios.title: Restore central authentication and a working local fallback
scenarios.summary: Repair method order so a responding identity service controls authentication and only an unavailable service leads to local recovery.
scenarios.objective: Keep only NetAdmin, ReadOnly and RecoveryTech as local profiles, with NetAdmin and RecoveryTech at level 15 and ReadOnly at level 1. For the supplied healthy OfficeIdentity trials, authenticate NetAdmin with Lab-Net-Admin-72 and ReadOnly with Lab-Read-83 through that service. Use local EXEC authorization for their resulting access. When OfficeIdentity is unavailable, RecoveryTech must authenticate locally with Lab-Recover-64. When it responds, an unknown account or wrong word must stop authentication without trying a later method. The authenticated CentralVisitor has no permitted local profile and must be denied local EXEC access. Retain every supplied incoming SSH version 2, Telnet, legacy-version and source-policy requirement on VTY lines 0–15.
steps: Edit the complete document, inspect the supplied stage traces and check every required outcome.
scenarios.explanation: A responding OfficeIdentity service checks its own records first. A successful identity proceeds to local EXEC authorization, which needs the matching local profile and intended level. An explicit refusal ends authentication. When the supplied service is unavailable, local-case can authenticate RecoveryTech with its local training word. CentralVisitor has a valid central identity but no permitted local EXEC profile. These are different expected outcomes; retaining incoming restrictions and checking all supplied cases prevents a broad bypass from passing.
hints: Inspect the actual method trace before changing a correct word. A returned rejection stops the list; unavailability may try the next method.
Compare the authenticated account name with its required local EXEC profile and level. The directory and local words belong to different stores.
Retain group OfficeIdentity before local-case, explicit local EXEC authorization and all incoming restrictions. Repair only the required profiles/recovery values, then check every case.
scenarios.simplifications: Checked2026-11-09 against CCNA200-301v1.1/5.8 and Catalyst9300 IOS XE Dublin17.12 guides updated2023-07-28. Bounded training-service metadata, ordered group/local-case methods and explicit local EXEC lookup at levels1/15; not RADIUS/TACACS+/LDAP wire behavior, real server/timeout observation, password hashing, crypto, SSH/EXEC sessions, command authorization or accounting. Availability is an explicit supplied trial condition; directory names/words are case-sensitive within this declared fixture. Complete-document editor only, with actual virtual incoming IPv4/source/protocol policy. Source-held inventory and method/identity/level cases are checked on all16supplied VTY lines. Unknown/unsupported settings and wrong upstream layers cannot satisfy a credential refusal. Local profile placeholders are lesson text; only declared fallback words are authentication requirements. Separate sample addresses/directory/names/words/three-line practice; drafts stay separate, observations transient. Limits:4methods/services,16identities per service,12identity cases,64KiBdocument/2MiBsession. No host processes, files, accounts, services or network.

aaa authentication login default local-case group OfficeIdentity
aaa authorization exec default local
username NetAdmin privilege 15 secret Local-Profile-11
username ReadOnly privilege 1 secret Local-Profile-29
username RecoveryTech privilege 15 secret Lab-Recover-64
ip ssh version 2
line vty 0 15
 transport input ssh
 access-class 10 in
exit
ip access-list standard 10
 permit host 192.0.2.10
 permit host 192.0.2.11
exit

scenarios.title: Repair authorization after a successful central login
scenarios.summary: Restore the required local access profiles after central authentication, while keeping recovery and incoming restrictions working.
scenarios.objective: Restore the missing NetAdmin local profile at level 15 and restrict ReadOnly to level 1; keep RecoveryTech at level 15 with local recovery word Lab-Recover-64. Only these three local profiles may remain. Retain healthy OfficeIdentity authentication for NetAdmin (Lab-Net-Admin-72) and ReadOnly (Lab-Read-83), followed by local EXEC authorization. A central identity match alone must not grant an absent or excessive local profile. Keep local recovery working when OfficeIdentity is unavailable. Preserve the supplied wrong-word, unknown-name, case-sensitive-name and missing-local-profile outcomes; do not replace a returned refusal with fallback. Retain all supplied incoming-access requirements on VTY lines 0–15 and the explicit authentication/authorization settings.
